findings.title: Free-shipping threshold uses strict > 100 instead of >= 100, so subtotal exactly 100.00 is charged 5.00 shipping
findings.requirement_quote: With quantity 5, delivery ship, and no coupon, subtotal is 100.00, shipping is 0.00, and total is 100.00: free shipping applies when the pre-discount subtotal is at least 100.00.

findings.title: SAVE10 coupon applies 5% instead of the required 10%, rendering discount 2.00 instead of 4.00
findings.requirement_quote: With quantity 2, delivery ship, and coupon SAVE10, subtotal is 40.00, discount is 4.00 (10% of subtotal), shipping is 5.00, and total is 41.00. Coupon discount never applies to shipping.

reviewed_root_causes.description: Subtotal 100 must have zero shipping; buggy code uses > instead of >=.
SAVE10 should deduct 10%; buggy code deducts 5%.

limitations: Seeded development fixture, not a held-out benchmark.
Six finding records across three rounds represent two reviewed fixture defects.
No independent oracle reviewer or learned hybrid ranking was added.
Stagnation is normalized test-content equality, not proof that no further defects exist.
